summary.text: John Albers, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2011 and represents District 56, which includes portions of Cherokee, Cobb and Fulton counties.

paragraphs.text: Albers is a former firefighter, and the legislature biography lists him as chairman of the Senate Committee on Public Safety.
Albers earned a Bachelor of Science in Organizational Leadership from the University of Louisville and is an executive and business owner.
